headline: Saturday clear: harvest onions, dig potatoes, tip canes.
weather_notes: Skip all watering today — yesterday's 0.33" rain plus today's 45% storm chance keeps soil saturated through Saturday.
Do all harvesting and digging Saturday — sunny 85°F with no storm risk is the first clean outdoor work window since the heat wave ended.

Cure harvested onions out of direct sun — lay pulled bulbs in shade before Sunday's 88°F accelerates post-harvest neck rot.
